newsitem.title: USA: CV Therapeutics, Biogen in collaboration.
newsitem.headline: CV Therapeutics, Biogen in collaboration.

text.p: CV Therapeutics Inc and Biogen Inc said Monday they would collaborate on development of CVT-124, a therapy for the treatment of edema associated with congestive heart failure.

CV will receive from Biogen up-front payments totaling $16 million, including $5 million in cash, a $7 million equity investment in CV stock at $10.45 per share, and advance funding of a development milestone and partial access to a line of credit, they said.
Biogen and its wholly owned subsidiary Biotech Manufacturing Ltd will receive exclusive worldwide rights to develop and sell CVT-124.
Biogen and CV will participate in developing the drug, but Biogen will pay all costs of commercializing the product.
Under the agreement, Biogen will pay CV significant milestone payments and royalties on clinical progress and product sales.
The drug is expected to enter a multi-center Phase II clinical trial within the next month.
